hypothesis: Instruction count is approximately a combination of per-chunk overhead, spatial work with distinct initial and subsequent chunk costs, and quadratic attention work.

pcvs.name: temporal_chunks
pcvs.rationale: Tracks encoder invocations and per-chunk Python, dispatch, and cache-management overhead.

pcvs.name: spatial_area
pcvs.rationale: Captures spatial work specific to the initial single-frame chunk and fixed spatial costs.

pcvs.name: chunk_spatial_work
pcvs.rationale: Models convolution, normalization, activation, and copying work across temporal chunks.

pcvs.name: attention_pair_work
pcvs.rationale: Models quadratic spatial attention work at the encoder's compressed resolution.
